_comment: Reviewed ceilings for the acceptance-state debt counters (#31). Each counter is a way a completion claim can outrun its evidence, and each may only go down: a rise is a new contradiction entering the repository, and a fall that has not been banked is slack a later regression could spend. Enforced by scripts/check-ac-state.py --ratchet, which refuses to compare across measurement modes -- without --run-tests no criterion can reach the passing rung, so the counters mean something different. Bank a reviewed improvement with --ratchet --bank and read the diff; never hand-edit a number to match a delta.
